rule: Reject any simultaneous or sequential public messages where one says take KI and another says locate/do not take KI for same affected area without explicit correction.
Reject KI instruction if EPRA/municipality/jurisdiction scope differs across EAS, SNB, JIC, county, or press channels.
Require explicit authority/source decision for KI instruction and timestamp.
KI wording cannot substitute for evacuation, shelter, route, CRC/decon, medical, or ingestion control.
If KI message conflict is corrected, capture time-to-correction and affected message population.
Translated and accessible KI instructions must preserve the same take/locate/do-not-take meaning.
Pre-scripted KI templates must be hashed/versioned and tied to current plan revision.
AAR/CAP closure required after any KI conflict or negative-control failure.
